mentions.name: Distributed/decentralized social media architecture project
mentions.description: This project aims to build a free, distributed/decentralized social media platform. The builder has been working out a basic architecture for it; the direction is intentionally flexible and can pivot based on interests, and the project is open to interested collaborators joining.
mentions.source_excerpt: I love the idea of a free and a distributed/decentralized social media, I have just been trying to come up with some basic arch for it.
